_comment: Phase 3 badges golden: the TLB reel (tlb_golden.json) as a MENTOR & STUDENT dialogue, language os. The student (the grey host badge) asks; the mentor (the OS badge) explains. Same facts as tlb_golden, every one from section 3.4. Also the stub answer for mentor_student on the paging lesson.
topic: Why does address translation need the TLB?
hook_question: Why does every memory lookup feel twice as slow?

shots.speech: Why does every memory lookup feel twice as slow?

captions.text: Why does every memory lookup feel twice as slow?
captions.speaker: STUDENT

shots.visual: Student badge asks; a memory lookup bar fills twice as long as it should; status pill 'Twice as slow'.

shots.speech: One small cache fixes this. Here is how.
shots.visual: Title card: series label, 'TLB', the promise line, three icon tiles.

shots.speech: Your program asks for one address. The page table says which frame holds that page. So where does the time go?

captions.text: Your program asks for one address.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

captions.text: The page table says which frame holds that page.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

captions.text: So where does the time go?
captions.speaker: STUDENT

shots.visual: Program chip asks for an address; a page table panel lights the matching frame.

shots.speech: But the page table lives in memory too. So every lookup first reads the table, then the data.

captions.text: But the page table lives in memory too.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

captions.text: So every lookup first reads the table, then the data.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: Two memory reads in a row: the table, then the data; status pill 'Two reads'.

shots.speech: Meet the TLB, a small cache. It keeps recent page to frame answers close by.

captions.text: It keeps recent page to frame answers close by.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: A small cache panel 'TLB' beside memory, holding recent page to frame pairs.

shots.speech: On a TLB hit, the frame number is ready at once. So I skip the table walk?

captions.text: On a TLB hit, the frame number is ready at once.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: Trigger chip 'TLB hit' pulses straight to the frame; the table walk is skipped.

shots.speech: Each entry maps a page number to a frame number. A miss walks the table once, then saves it.

captions.text: Each entry maps a page number to a frame number.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

captions.text: A miss walks the table once, then saves it.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: Icon row: page table, TLB, hit — each lit as it is named.

shots.speech: Now the same lookup reads memory once, and my program runs fast.

captions.text: Now the same lookup reads memory once, and my program runs fast.
captions.speaker: STUDENT

shots.visual: The hook's lookup bar again, now one short read; status pill 'Fast'.

shots.speech: Remember: the page table lives in memory. The TLB caches recent answers. A hit skips the walk.

captions.text: Remember: the page table lives in memory.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: Takeaway list: three rows with the grid, memory and bolt icons.

shots.speech: Follow for more, one idea at a time.

captions.text: Follow for more, one idea at a time.
captions.speaker: MENTOR

shots.visual: End card: Up next, Follow button, tags.
